summary: To make docs findable: use clear headings, use numbered lists for procedures, and avoid linking to GitHub blobs.
questions: How do I make my documentation easier to find with search engines?

answer_card.title: Writing findable docs
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Use headings that clearly reflect the topic.
2. Use numbered lists for procedures or high-level steps.
3. Avoid linking to GitHub blobs.
